summary: Iteration 5 — auth + admin approval + JWT-scoped notes + scanner + camera + Gmail-recipients-in-to fix. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing (test_auth_iter5.py) covering admin seed/login, register (pending/duplicate/short-pw), 403 for non-approved login, /auth/me, admin endpoints (pending/users/approve/revoke/delete + cascade), notes 401 without token, cross-user isolation (404 for foreign notes on GET/PATCH/DELETE/photos/regenerate), bulk-delete only deletes caller's ids, PDF parse (4 numeric WRs, 1 alphanumeric skipped, notes carry user_id). Frontend Playwright: auth-card visible on first load, pending user login shows 'Account in attesa di approvazione', registration switches back to login mode, admin login → main content + ADMIN badge + Pannello Admin button, admin modal shows pending users, Approva moves them to approved section, PDF upload creates 4 note cards (defaultOpen), photo-camera input has capture=environment + accept=image/*, photo-gallery input has no capture and accept=image/*, Gmail button opens mail.google.com URL with 5 recipients in to= param and body containing only the note text (no recipients concatenated), scanner-modal opens with scan-target-cpe/ont buttons and closes cleanly (camera fails gracefully in headless without crashing). Standalone offline: /standalone.html first visit shows 'Imposta password' mode, setting a 4+ char password hides overlay and stores hash in localStorage, reload with sessionStorage cleared shows 'Sblocca l\'app' mode, wrong password → 'Password errata' toast, correct password → 'App sbloccata' + unlock, Gmail URL patterns in source use `to=${encodeURIComponent(to)}` and `body=${encodeURIComponent(noteText)}` with no recipient concatenation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user rejects approved=false with 403 even when the token is valid — good, but note admin approval revocation only takes effect on next request (existing JWTs remain live until 30d expiry). Consider a token-invalidation list or shorter expiry + refresh flow if security is critical.

seed_admin() force-updates the admin's password on every startup if it differs from .env — this is fine but means changing ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env immediately overwrites. Documented in test_credentials.md.
CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; harmless for the current Bearer-token flow (no cookies), but should be tightened for production.
App.js NoteCard defaults defaultOpen for newly-parsed notes → all 4 cards auto-expand after upload. Minor UX consideration for lots of notes.
standalone.html toast placement (top-right) can overlap the header 'Blocca' button briefly; cosmetic only.
